phase: ## Phase 2: MP3 copies in the wrapper
summary: Phase 2 fails the audit because binary lookup can bypass the fail-fast check. All 91 targeted tests pass. All committed audio files decode.
blocking_findings: F1 [Major] Green: scripts/sound-set.mjs:75-92 accepts directories as binaries and checks unresolved basenames against the working directory. With FFMPEG_BIN=<directory>, the wrapper renders alpha.ogg before reporting ffmpeg failed with exit null. An executable ./ffmpeg outside PATH produces the same result when the default binary is absent from PATH. A directory named ffmpeg in an earlier PATH entry also masks a later executable. These cases violate AC2's missing-binary line and the strategy's zero-render fail-fast rule. Resolve only executable files from PATH. Reject failed lookup before target preparation or rendering. Add failing-first fixtures for these cases.
nonblocking_findings: F2 [Minor] Red: tests/sound-set-mp3.test.ts:98-104 and 148-233 always supply an absolute FFMPEG_BIN. The suite also lacks an MP3 target obstruction fixture. Two independent wrapper mutations each pass all 91 tests: removing PATH lookup and delaying MP3 preparation until after the Ogg render. Add default-PATH, basename-override, and blocked-MP3 fixtures. Require zero earshot calls when MP3 preparation fails.

F3 [Minor] Green: measure/tracks/audio_game_integration_20261014/plan.md:142-145 and green-p2.log:87-91 claim that every Ogg changes 24 bytes. The independent render changes 32 bytes in right.ogg and level-end.ogg, and 24 bytes in the other files. The two longer files have four pages; the others have three. Every changed byte belongs to a stream serial or page CRC. Replace the fixed count with the observed per-file counts or a page-based description. The existing plan note is sufficient for this container nondeterminism; a new debt row is unnecessary.

F4 [Minor] Red: measure/runs/audio_game_integration_20261014/red-p2.log:6-7,41 records phase_base_sha 16b398b595354f5da754268f1b32c8e864b9312a. That object does not exist. The supplied phase base is 16b398b595354f5da275268f1b32c8e864b9312a. Correct the immutable provenance fields. Independent historical test runs reproduce the reported Red counts with the supplied base.
